workflows.content:
name: ci

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - name: Run tests
        # FixtureTransport + mock-mode defaults keep this hermetic: no Qloo key needed.
        run: python -m pytest -q

name: native-plan-week-browser

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'tools/native_plan_to_week.mjs'
      - 'tools/check_native_plan_week_browser.mjs'
      - 'tests/test_native_plan_week.py'
      - 'tastetable_cli.py'
      - 'agent.py'
      - 'constraints.py'
      - 'qloo_client.py'
      - 'personas.py'
      - 'fixtures/qloo_fixtures.json'
      - 'static/**'
      - '.github/workflows/native-plan-week-browser.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'tools/native_plan_to_week.mjs'
      - 'tools/check_native_plan_week_browser.mjs'
      - 'tests/test_native_plan_week.py'
      - 'tastetable_cli.py'
      - 'agent.py'
      - 'constraints.py'
      - 'qloo_client.py'
      - 'personas.py'
      - 'fixtures/qloo_fixtures.json'
      - 'static/**'
      - '.github/workflows/native-plan-week-browser.yml'

concurrency:
  group: native-plan-week-browser-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  receive-week:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 8
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # Existing maintained pin.
      - name: Require cached Node 22, Python and installed system Chrome
        id: runtime
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          NATIVE_WEEK_NODE=
          for NATIVE_WEEK_NODE_DIR in "${RUNNER_TOOL_CACHE}/node"/22.*; do
            if [[ -x "${NATIVE_WEEK_NODE_DIR}/x64/bin/node" && -f "${NATIVE_WEEK_NODE_DIR}/x64.complete" ]]; then
              NATIVE_WEEK_NODE="${NATIVE_WEEK_NODE_DIR}/x64/bin/node"
            fi
          done
          [[ -n "${NATIVE_WEEK_NODE}" ]] || { echo "A complete cached Node 22 is required."; exit 1; }
          NATIVE_WEEK_BROWSER=
          for NATIVE_WEEK_BROWSER_NAME in google-chrome google-chrome-stable chromium chromium-browser; do
            if command -v "${NATIVE_WEEK_BROWSER_NAME}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              NATIVE_WEEK_BROWSER="$(command -v "${NATIVE_WEEK_BROWSER_NAME}")"
              break
            fi
          done
          [[ -n "${NATIVE_WEEK_BROWSER}" ]] || { echo "An installed Chrome/Chromium is required."; exit 1; }
          NATIVE_WEEK_PYTHON="$(command -v python3)"
          "${NATIVE_WEEK_NODE}" --version
          "${NATIVE_WEEK_BROWSER}" --version
          "${NATIVE_WEEK_PYTHON}" --version
          printf 'node=%s\nbrowser=%s\npython=%s\n' "${NATIVE_WEEK_NODE}" "${NATIVE_WEEK_BROWSER}" "${NATIVE_WEEK_PYTHON}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
      - name: Receive actual native result, saved file and unchanged browser consumer
        env:
          NATIVE_WEEK_PYTHON: ${{ steps.runtime.outputs.python }}
        run: '"${{ steps.runtime.outputs.node }}" tools/check_native_plan_week_browser.mjs --browser "${{ steps.runtime.outputs.browser }}" --output "${RUNNER_TEMP}/native-plan-week-receiving"'
      - name: Preserve bounded native inputs, actual downloads and browser artifacts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # Official v4 pin.
        with:
          name: native-plan-week-receiving-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/native-plan-week-receiving
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
          compression-level: 6

name: saved-week-comparison

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'static/**'
      - 'tests/*.mjs'
      - 'tests/*.cjs'
      - 'tests/fixtures/**'
      - '.github/workflows/week-compare.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'static/**'
      - 'tests/*.mjs'
      - 'tests/*.cjs'
      - 'tests/fixtures/**'
      - '.github/workflows/week-compare.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  compare-week:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 3
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # Existing maintained pin.
      - name: Test comparison and existing browser domain modules on cached Node 22
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          COMPARE_WEEK_NODE=
          for COMPARE_WEEK_NODE_DIR in "${RUNNER_TOOL_CACHE}/node"/22.*; do
            if [[ -x "${COMPARE_WEEK_NODE_DIR}/x64/bin/node" && -f "${COMPARE_WEEK_NODE_DIR}/x64.complete" ]]; then
              COMPARE_WEEK_NODE="${COMPARE_WEEK_NODE_DIR}/x64/bin/node"
            fi
          done
          [[ -n "${COMPARE_WEEK_NODE}" ]] || { echo "A complete cached Node 22 is required."; exit 1; }
          "${COMPARE_WEEK_NODE}" --version
          "${COMPARE_WEEK_NODE}" --test tests/*.mjs tests/*.cjs

workflowGuard.decision: All current push events restricted to main; PR events also exist. No create/issues/issue_comment event. Permit new non-main branch without PR after fresh branch/head/authority checks; hold PR/main integration.
